subject.title: [Feature]: Hand delegated setup to a secure human surface

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed core setup-handoff contract now, with authenticated Control UI confirmation as the canonical secure surface, rather than leaving delegated interactive setup to manual navigation or an external extension?
rationale: The request adds a new privileged Gateway/client interaction and determines where credential-bearing setup may begin; implementation cannot safely choose its permanent product and security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow core handoff
options.body: Approve an additive, expiring, credential-free admin event and Control UI confirmation flow that launches only existing secure setup APIs after explicit human action.

options.title: Keep manual setup navigation
options.body: Retain the current refusal behavior and document the manual channel/provider setup path while deferring this product surface.

options.title: Require an extension seam first
options.body: Defer implementation until maintainers define a generic plugin or client capability boundary suitable for secure setup handoffs.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow core handoff
recommendation.body: Approve an additive, expiring, credential-free admin event and Control UI confirmation flow that launches only existing secure setup APIs after explicit human action.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue contains the concrete product and security design that requires sponsorship or narrowing.
